thresholdNote: Calibrated pipeline: gamma-0 from GCOV float (pair granules), dB, 12-setting ensemble on the native 20 m grid (thresholds 3/4.5/6 dB x median 3/5 x MMU 100/350 px), pair delta referenced to a stable east-farmland control patch (seasonal shift removed). Robust = persists in all 12 settings — a robustness measure, not a probability.

candidates.title: Western channel belt — south reach
candidates.question: In July this ground returned almost no radar signal — open water. By October it is among the brightest ground in the case. Emerged char, new crop, or settlement edge?

crosscheck.reading: C-band backs the emergence: Sentinel-1's water-like (dark) fraction inside this core fell from 0.42 to 0.00 and VV rose from -15.8 to -10.0 dB. But optical NDWI saw no open water here on either clear date — so July's radar-dark surface may have been smooth wet mud or shallow turbid water, not deep open water. The field question is what replaced it.

candidates.title: Western channel belt — north reach
candidates.question: Open water here in July; bright, rough ground by October while the river fell. Sandbar surface, ploughed char, or homesteads moving in?

crosscheck.reading: Sentinel-1's dark fraction fell from 0.09 to 0.01 and optical saw no open water on either clear date. Consistent with a wet surface drying and roughening as the river fell — not a lake draining. What the surface is now is exactly what a person standing on it can say.

candidates.title: Western channel belt — mid reach
candidates.question: The radar saw water in July and dry bright ground in October. What is standing on it now?

crosscheck.reading: Sentinel-1's dark fraction fell from 0.19 to 0.00 (VV -13.8 to -11.3 dB); optical saw no open water on either clear date. Two independent sensors agree this ground emerged or dried between July and October. What grew, cracked or was built on it is the open question.

placeWatch.bn: স্যাটেলাইট বলছে: জুলাইয়ে যমুনার পশ্চিম পাড়ের এই অংশটা ছিল পানির নিচে বা ভেজা মসৃণ মাটি। অক্টোবরে নদীর পানি কমতেই তিনটি বড় জায়গায় শুকনো, খসখসে মাটি বেরিয়ে এসেছে। সেখানে এখন কী আছে — নতুন চর, ফসল, নাকি মানুষের বসতি — সেটা আপনার চোখে দেখে বলতে হবে। পরের ছবি আসবে 25 October 2026-এ।
placeWatch.en: The satellite says: in July this western-bank reach was under water or smooth wet ground. As the river fell, three large patches emerged bright and rough by October. What is on them now — new char, crops, or homes — is for your eyes to answer. Next picture arrives 25 October 2026.
